newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market rates ease slightly.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market rates ease slightly.

text.p: Pakistan's interbank money market eased slightly on Sunday and dealers said rates were likely to remain unchanged on Monday.
"Interbank money market opened with bids and offers in the range of 14 percent and 16 percent respectively," one dealer of the Karachi-based Standard Chartered Bank said.
Some deals were finalised between 14.5 and 15 percent initially, but later rates came down between 10.5 and 11 percent amid inflows of funds in the banking system, the dealer said.
"The market is expected to remain at the same levels tomorrow," the dealer said.
